claims.text: Reconstructed in the Open Air Museum; its ancient original location is disputed.
This limestone chapel preserves Senusret I’s jubilee decoration. Four internal pillars are surrounded by twelve outer pillars.
Personified regions and their measurements occur on the base; this is a promising precisely located reading lesson.
An initial festival-kiosk function followed by conversion to a bark shrine is proposed.
Amenhotep III reused the dismantled blocks in the Third Pylon.

caveats: Present access, exact viewpoints and condition have not been field-verified.
